facts.note: At the nine o'clock temple bell Aurèle had everyone bring out their watches, and the narrator's watch was two minutes ahead of the bell.

Piquet in the salon until a quarter to eleven by the narrator's watch. He then went out to the hall for his cigar case in his coat. Madame began the piano as he went out and stopped when he came back. The music named (Chopin) is not part of the fact.
After he sat down again, the hall clock struck eleven a moment later.
